en:
There's an angel statue and a demon statue next
to the stairs. Don't chapels usually have these?

<CLT=cltMIND>This place makes you feel like there is
no god, but then there's this...

<CLT=cltMIND>Is that coincidence or just
Monokuma's sense of humor?

Just looking at the school building from the
courtyard, the 5th floor didn't look this big...
Did they recently expand it...just for us?

This has a completely different feel 
from the 4th floor.

Huh? That door over there is just plain 
suspicious. Could it be...

Huh? That door over there is just plain 
suspicious. Could it be...

<CLT=cltMIND>This looks like an <CLT=cltMIND>Ultimate lab<CLT=cltMIND>.
I should check inside.

<CLT=cltMIND>This also looks like an <CLT=cltMIND>Ultimate lab<CLT=cltMIND>.
But whose lab is it?
I should check inside to be sure.

<CLT=cltMIND>This door certainly matches
the atmosphere of this floor...

<CLT=cltMIND>It doesn't look like it will open...
I suppose I'll have to leave it be for now.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.
